title: Qualifying monthly groups
brief: Filter completed groups rather than individual transactions.
instructions: Group paid UTC 2024 transaction revenue by month and category identity. Keep totals at least 100.00; do not introduce empty groups.
For paid reporting activity, include timestamps at or after 2024-01-01 00:00:00 UTC and exclude timestamps at or after 2025-01-01 00:00:00 UTC.
Return only the declared output columns, in their declared order and exact SQL types. Follow the output ordering contract; NULL ordering is explicit.
starterExplanation: This starter exposes order_id,ordered_at,status from orders without solving qualifying monthly groups.

hints.text: Join items to products, group by UTC month and category identity, then apply the threshold.
